anomalies.description: Soldiers are actively firing rifles from behind barricades; muzzle flashes and smoke are visible in frames f0–f2.
A person in the foreground fires a weapon, producing a visible muzzle flash and smoke trail at 18.0s (f4) and a sustained smoke plume at 18.5s (f5).

A large explosion erupts at the building facade in frame f14, followed by a fireball and debris in f15, indicating a sudden blast event.; A large explosion erupts near the center of the street, with bright orange fireball and expanding smoke at 19.5s (f7), followed by continued fire and debris at 20.0s (f8).; A second, more intense explosion occurs further down the street, with a large fireball and thick smoke visible at 20.5s (f9) and persisting through 21.0s (f10).
A large, bright orange explosion erupts in the street, producing a fireball and dense smoke, centered around a vehicle or object near the middle of the frame.

Soldiers are aiming rifles in a combat-ready stance; while no muzzle flash is visible, the posture, weapon orientation, and context (urban combat, immediate preceding/following fighting) strongly suggest active firing or imminent shooting.

A group of soldiers in tactical gear advances rapidly through debris-strewn streets while holding weapons at the ready; their coordinated movement and posture indicate active close-quarters combat engagement.

A large armored military vehicle is seen driving through a damaged urban street with dust and debris, suggesting recent vehicular impact or destruction; however, no direct collision is captured in frames f0–f1. The scene implies aftermath of a crash or combat-related vehicle damage.

Multiple individuals lie motionless on the ground near vehicles in a parking lot (frames f2–f15), while armed personnel stand nearby observing; one person appears to be lying face-down with possible blood pooling, indicating they are helpless and possibly injured or deceased. No active physical assault is shown, but the context strongly suggests prior abuse or lethal force resulting in incapacitation.
Multiple individuals lie motionless on the pavement near vehicles; armed personnel stand over them without apparent medical aid, suggesting possible mistreatment of incapacitated persons.

A severely damaged, burnt-out pickup truck is parked next to a black Ford van; the truck shows extensive fire damage and deformation consistent with a prior collision and/or fire, and remains stationary throughout the sequence.

A person lies motionless on the ground in a parking lot while several individuals stand nearby, some appearing to observe or interact with the prone figure; no active combat is visible, but the context suggests potential abuse of a helpless individual.
